title: E2E2Z
shortDescription: An early preview of the Free2Z private messaging app.
fullDescription:
E2E2Z is the dedicated Free2Z messaging app, designed to keep device messaging keys separate from the ZUULI wallet.

This is an experimental internal preview. On iPhone and Android, enrollment requests are passed to ZUULI for confirmation. This build uses a disposable internal directory; free2z operates the log and its witnesses, so they are not independent. The directory is erased before public launch.

An unenrolled device cannot start a conversation. Enrollment, directory availability, and connectivity determine which messaging features are available. Desktop builds cannot enroll through ZUULI. Diagnostics stay on the device unless you choose to share them.
